title: Excessive Shadow Views & Cubemap Shadow Pass Overhead
fix_rationale: The GPU is repeatedly rendering scene geometry across multiple shadow views per frame (e.g. 6 faces per point-light cubemap). Caching static shadow depths, disabling shadows on fill lights, or switching to Virtual Shadow Maps will eliminate redundant passes.
evidence_template: {timer} took {ms} ms ({share}% of excess time) executing multiple shadow projection passes.

fixes.text: Audit local point and spot lights: disable Cast Shadows on non-critical fill and ambient lights.
Enable Virtual Shadow Maps (r.Shadow.Virtual.Enable 1) to replace traditional cubemap shadow projections with clipmap caching.
Increase shadow radius culling threshold (r.Shadow.RadiusThreshold 0.03 to 0.06) to cull distant local light shadows.
Clamp maximum Cascaded/Cubemap shadow resolution (r.Shadow.MaxCSMResolution 1024 or 512).
Reduce light attenuation radius to prevent large overlapping shadow projection volumes.

verify: Verify in the trace that Nanite::DrawGeometry and ShadowDepths Face calls/frame drop toward baseline (e.g. under 6 views/frame).
